channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dalton Knecht | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dalton Knecht from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Dalton Knecht is not expected to make the Lakers' regular season roster. Lakers have 16 guaranteed contracts and going into the season you can only have 15 guaranteed contracts. Apparently, Bronny James and Jaden Hardy have been outplaying him in campand he's viewed as the odd man out. And it's crazy because Dalton Knecht seemed to like he had a little bit of promise to him, but after that trade that got voided by the Hornets to bring him in and send Mark Williams to the Lakers, the Lakers voided the trade because of Mark Williams' back. Dalton Knecht just been in purgatory ever since and ultimately I think it ruined him.”

Draymond Green on Bronny James, Jaden Hardy, Mark Williams, Dalton Knecht, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: JJ Redick on Reggie Miller, Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:JJ Redick on Dalton Knecht:

“Reggie [Miller] and I were talking before the game and he was like, ‘It’s high praise to say he’s in the top 1% of shooters …’ Well, nah, he’s in the top 1%. … That was supernatural what he just did”

JJ Redick on Reggie Miller, Dalton Knecht, Oct 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: JJ Redick on Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Ryan Ward:JJ Redick on Dalton Knecht:

“Obviously, we know in the NBA you have to be a two-way player to make an impact, and defensively he's got to improve like any rookie.”

JJ Redick on Dalton Knecht, Jul 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Dane Johnson on Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Coach Dane Johnson on Dalton Knecht:

“He’s had a great couple of days (of practice). Today, a couple shots didn't fall for him, but in practice he’s brought effort, energy. He just plays hard and will do whatever you tell him to do ... he’s had a great camp so far.”

Dane Johnson on Dalton Knecht, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Lakers’ LeBron James on rookie Dalton Knecht:

“Dalton, besides Bronny, was my favorite player in college basketball. … I did not think he would fall to 17 at all.… I’m glad he did.”

LeBron James on Dalton Knecht, Jul 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Rob Pelinka on Dalton Knecht:

“We would have never imagined a player as skilled and perfect for our needs would be there [at 17].”

Rob Pelinka on Dalton Knecht, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.
